params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: key
params.description: Key to associate with object: a standard key name (e.g. "B") or a bracketed special-key constant (e.g. "[F1]", "[return]", "[esc]") from the Shortcut and Associated Keys theme

params.name: modifiers
params.description: Modifier key mask or sum of masks

sentinelValues.meaning: Command key mask -- Ctrl under Windows, Command under macOS
Control key mask -- Ctrl under macOS, or right-click under Windows and macOS
Option key mask -- Alt (Option under macOS)
Shift key mask -- Windows and macOS

overloads.semanticRole: Sets or dynamically modifies, for the current process, the keyboard shortcut (key plus optional modifier mask) associated with the object(s) designated by object and *.

constraints: If modifiers is omitted, the shortcut fires as soon as the plain key is pressed with no modifier -- reserve this for specialized interfaces.
modifiers is a sum of one or more of Command key mask (256), Control key mask (4096), Option key mask (2048), Shift key mask (512).
